rule.producer: Every exact complete qotal token installs/replaces one opaque formal slot keyed TAL; the stored value is its original occurrence ID, with no English meaning or semantic participant inferred.
rule.consumer: Only an exact consecutive same-line chey tal pair, with a definite intervening source gap, requires the latest earlier qotal occurrence in the current scope. Other chey and tal occurrences are outside this explicitly conditional grammar; their exclusion is paid, not deletion from the text.
rule.two_scopes: Primary comparison: clear all slots at each mapped scene boundary versus carry the slot across the complete f83r page. No mid-record resets, lookahead, fallback producer, qotol/qotchedy aliases or implicit initial values.
rule.limits: This is a proposed dependency skeleton, not a complete page grammar and not an inferred meaning of qo, chey, qotal or tal. The relation between qotal and tal is a hypothesis, not established morphology. A nonreference combination is still an equal rival.
